meta.description: Emission factor library for CarbonPilot. Values are kgCO2e per unit of activity. Curated from public datasets so every calculation has a traceable source trail.
meta.note: Factors are point estimates for prototype use. Production would pull live factors from Climatiq or the issuing authority.

factors.label: Purchased electricity — grid mix
factors.source: IEA Electricity Maps / GHG Protocol Scope 2 (location-based)

factors.label: Purchased electricity — Indonesia grid
factors.source: Indonesia MEMR grid emission factor (Jamali) / IEA

factors.label: Purchased electricity — UK grid
factors.source: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors 2026 (electricity generated)

factors.label: Cloud compute (vCPU-hour, includes PUE + embodied)
factors.source: Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology (min/max watts per vCPU x PUE 1.2, + embodied)

factors.label: Cloud storage (GB-month, includes replication + embodied)
factors.source: Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology (SSD/HDD energy x PUE x replication factor)

factors.label: Cloud data transfer (GB egress)
factors.source: Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology (network energy intensity)

factors.label: Business travel — flight (blended short/long-haul, with radiative forcing)
factors.source: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors 2026 — domestic/short-haul/long-haul weighted by typical corporate mix, with RF
